item.title: Geraldton water polo round 10: Top-of-table tussles and derby delight served up ahead of Christmas break
item.description: Round 10 of the Geraldton water polo season shapes as another busy and bruising weekend, with plenty at stake across the grades as teams jostle for position and pride.

item.title: From The Rec to Punt Road: How Geraldton’s Fina Dethlefsen’s footy journey was shaped by her hometown
item.description: After being taken in Monday night’s AFLW draft, Geraldton’s latest footy talent Fina Dethlefsen opens up on how her footy in the Mid West shaped her journey.

item.title: Central Regional TAFE international student Louise Hill recognised for her excellence
item.description: A student from Central Regional TAFE has been awarded WA international VET student of the year.

item.title: Energy Minister Amber-Jade Sanderson says she is willing to consider doubling extended outage payment
item.description: WA’s Energy Minister says she is willing to “consider” doubling the extended outage payment available to tens of thousands of Mid West households and businesses impacted by last weekend’s mass blackout.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton approves masterplan to give Spalding Park new life
item.description: The first step has been taken to restore and develop Spalding Park as a multi-use sporting venue.

item.title: Expressions of interest sought for expert reference group to support On Track to Thrive pilot program
item.description: The hunt is on for people with “cultural, community and child development expertise” to advise on a groundbreaking youth justice initiative to be rolled out as a pilot program in Geraldton early next year.

item.title: Geraldton’s Youth Centre and foreshore nominated for most accessible spaces in WA
item.description: Geraldton’s Youth Centre and foreshore have been recognised for their accessibility and inclusion at the Most Accessible Communities WA Awards last week.

item.title: Power outages impact telecommunications across Mid West, difficult to contact emergency services
item.description: Mid West residents were left without phone communication for days during power outages in what has been called a “significant problem”.

item.title: Bookara crash: 13-year-old girl airlifted to Perth after Toyota HiLux rollover on Brand Highway
item.description: Major crash investigators are probing a car rollover which seriously injured a 13-year-old girl on Friday night.

item.title: Bureau of Meteorology forecasts Christmas Day in Geraldton to reach a sweltering 43C
item.description: If you thought earlier forecasts for Christmas Day were hot, then the latest outlook is sure to give you a meltdown.
